GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 350 (22 May 46) CIE
(SCAPIN-976)
APO 500
22 May 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Educational Employment of Demobilized Military Personnel.
1. Reference is made to Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government AG 350 (30 Oct 45) CIE, subject: “Investigation, Screening and Certification of Teachers and Educational Officials”, paragraph 1c.
2. All persons demobilized from the Japanese military forces will be declared immediately eligible for educational employment upon qualifying and receiving certificates of acceptability provided for by Imperial Ordinance No.263, promulgated 7 May 1946.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B.M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
